newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone editor charged with sedition.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone editor charged with sedition.

text.p: Sierra Leone newspaper editor Hilton Fyle appeared before a Freetown magistrate on Saturday charged with seditious publication.

Fyle, a former presenter with the British Broadcasting Corporation's Africa service radio, pleaded not guilty to three counts of publishing a false report likely to cause alarm. He was freed on bail of 10 million leones ($10,000). The charge arose from a story on Monday in Fyle's weekly, "1 2 3", alleging that justice officials accepted bribes to drop a fraud case against a former foreign minister and a businessman.
On Friday the editor of another newspaper, "The Torchlight", was sentenced to a month in prison for contempt of the assembly.
Editor Shaka Tarrawalie had pleaded guilty after he was summoned for a story in his newspaper last week accusing lawmakers of accepting bribes from the government of President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah.
